Thanks again for the time today — really appreciated the candid conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary of priorities you called out:
- Latency and predictable p95 for chat/generation flows (mobile-first experience)
- Unit economics: per-call and per-token cost visibility
- Observability: per-route dashboards, tracing, and retention for audit
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 scope, audit logs, and VPC options

What we heard you want to validate in the PoC:
1) Latency comparison (p50/p95) vs your current Bedrock endpoints across your typical prompt set
2) Per-token cost comparison across identical throughput targets
3) Observability depth: per-request traces, token-level cost breakdown, and retention/export to your SIEM

Proposed next steps (high level):
- We run a 48-hour A/B test (Redwood vs Bedrock) using your prompt set (attach: Acme_prompt_set_v1.txt)
- Rishi will own the test plan and execution; Neha will assist on security/compliance questions and evidence we should prepare
- We will provide a dashboard snapshot and a short report with p50/p95, tokens/sec, and estimated run-rate cost (attach: Redwood_PoC_TestPlan.pdf)

If that sounds good I’ll schedule a 30–45 minute technical kickoff with Rishi and Neha — proposed times below. Also attaching our SOC2 overview per your ask.

Jordan — quick answers inline and some detail on the PoC plan.

- Streaming & function calling: yes — Redwood supports streaming tokens, chunked responses, and structured function/tool-calling. We include delta-stream events for UI clients and guarantee backpressure handling for mobile.
- Per-token cost breakdown: we provide token-level cost attribution on the response object (and aggregated per-route dashboards).
- Log export: we can forward audit logs and traces to your Splunk/GCS/S3 endpoint; retention policy is configurable per deployment (we'll surface defaults in the PoC report).

Competitive differentiators to validate in the PoC:
1) Unified API across hosted/dedicated/private so the integration work you do once can run in prod-dedicated or private (if you need on-prem later)
2) Observability: per-route dashboards, token-level cost, real-time tracing (OpenTelemetry) and export hooks to your SIEM
3) Cost controls: intelligent batching and caching that reduces per-token spend without degrading p95 latency for interactive flows

I'll have Rishi attach a short technical runbook and the specific metrics we'll capture — proposed kickoff times: Mon 3/2 10:00am PT or Tue 3/3 9:00am PT. Which works for you?

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: PoC runbook + metrics to capture (Redwood vs Bedrock)

Hi Jordan / team — nice to e-meet. Per the kickoff, here's the concise test plan I'll run with your prompt set and the metrics we'll capture. Full PDF attached to the HubSpot record.

Test plan (48–72 hour):
- A/B traffic split (50/50) for 48 hours on identical request distribution using your prompt set
- Payloads: streaming & non-streaming variants, function-calling flows
- Throughput targets: baseline 200 rps sustained, short bursts to 1k rps to exercise autoscaling

Metrics to capture (per-request and aggregated):
- Latency: p50, p90, p95 (overall and per-route)
- Token throughput: tokens/sec, tokens/call
- Cost attribution: estimated $/1M tokens and per-response token breakdown
- Errors: HTTP 5xx, model error types, and token truncation rates
- Observability: OpenTelemetry traces (Jaeger-style spans), distributed trace IDs, and per-token span timing
- Retention/export: verify Splunk export for audit logs and S3 dump for token-level records

Operational controls we will validate:
- Canary rollout: staged ramp (5% -> 25% -> 50%) with automated rollback triggers on p95 or error thresholds
- Dedicated capacity option: reserved pool to eliminate noisy neighbor variance (we can quantify delta vs hosted)

Deliverables by end of PoC:
- Dashboard screenshots (per-route latency, cost heatmap, traces)
- Short report with p50/p95 comparison, cost delta, and recommended config changes
- Actionable recommendations to meet your p95 SLO and cost target

Links / references: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-014 — I've uploaded the runbook and sample dashboard there.

I'll kick off the A/B as soon as we align on the exact traffic window and we have the Splunk endpoint for log export. Proposed kickoff 3/2 10:00am PT.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
